selection_blindness: No E prediction content was inspected while screening these candidates.

protocol_reference.status: internal project protocol v1; not a sponsor-confirmed interpretation
protocol_reference.relevant_rule: Two independent comparable source families, at least one public-discussion source; zero baseline, weak coverage, source conflict, cap, or event-relevance uncertainty stays unknown.

measurement_rules.windows: D0 excluded; baseline D-7 through D-1 and observation D+1 through D+7, full UTC days, for triage only.
measurement_rules.source_family: Hacker News Algolia and PullPush Reddit archive are treated as separate platforms; Reddit submissions and comments remain one platform family.
measurement_rules.counts: Successful returned matches are not automatically event-relevant. Search hits must be content-relevance screened; HTTP errors are missing evidence, never zero.
measurement_rules.data_retention: No author names, raw comment text, or Reddit item identifiers retained in this screen. HN parent titles are summarized only where needed to document false-match contamination.
